No red screen anywhere; no new console errors related to iteration 7. Cleanup verified: only the seed 'Monthly rent receipt' template remains for alex; created Await was deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:883-901 next_run() — clamps dayOfMonth to 1..28 which sensibly avoids Feb/30-day-month edge cases; note picking dom=15 in Sept 2026 produces 2026-10-15 09:00Z because current UTC is past the 15th. Behavior matches spec 'this or next month'.

server.py:949-959 patch_template — always writes nextRunAt to the update set even when the schedule keys are not in the patch (fine, it's re-set from unchanged fields). Consider omitting the extra write to save one Mongo op.
server.py:908-923 run_template — sets doc.nextReminderAt = expectedAt, sourceAppLabel 'Recurring'; matches the frontend contract used to attribute the item.
templates.tsx:100 — Pill component receives the same testID whether Active or Paused, so tests can read the text. Good.

template-edit.tsx:47-52 — Prefill for editing runs whenever existing.data changes, but doesn't reset the local state when navigating from an item with the 'recurring' route params. In practice params.id is undefined for that case so the prefill happens from URL params, which was verified end-to-end.

ShareRecapCard.tsx:35 — Uses captureRef result 'data-uri' on web then creates <a download>. Works in Playwright's expect_download because the anchor click triggers a real download event. Verified filename prefix 'await-week-'.
CategoryInsights.tsx:44-67 — Rows render for every category returned (including 0% slip). Progress bar width uses (r.slipRate ?? 0)*100 which is 0 for null; visually fine.
recap.tsx:41-45 — recap-share-card-cta and recap-share-button both open the same sheet; verified both entry points.
